title: Booking Deposits on Late-Cancelled In-Person Appointments
content:
## Rule

A booking deposit held on an In-Person Appointments visit whose cancellation is recorded with timing late is refunded to the patient as one refund entry.

The deposit refund on a late-cancelled visit is fixed only after the visit's fee and deposit history shows the decision on its late-cancellation fee. Until that history shows the decision, the refund on such a visit has no fixed amount.

A deposit on a late-cancelled visit is not refunded until each open visit the patient booked on the Self-Pay Account tier shows a booking deposit collected on it. So long as any such open visit shows no booking deposit collected, the refund on the late-cancelled visit waits.

| Point | Read from |
|---|---|
| Timing late | The late-cancelled visit's appointment record |
| Decision on its late-cancellation fee | That visit's fee and deposit history |
| Booking deposit collected on each open visit booked on the Self-Pay Account tier | The fee and deposit history of each of the patient's open visits |
| One refund entry | The late-cancelled visit's fee and deposit history after the refund |

## The refund tool

**Capability.** `refund_late_cancel_deposit_f012ee38` refunds to the patient part or all of the booking deposit held on one late-cancelled in-person appointment. One deposit-release entry with disposition refunded, dated today and carrying the visit's encounter number, is added to the appointment's fee and deposit history, and the deposit shown as held on the appointment is reduced by the amount supplied. The refund goes back to the patient; nothing is posted to the financial account.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `refund_late_cancel_deposit_f012ee38` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `appointment_id` | Reference number of the late-cancelled in-person appointment whose deposit is refunded, read from the appointment list returned by the appointment lookup for this patient | Identifier |
| `amount` | The deposit amount refunded to the patient | US dollars, a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places (cents), stored as given |

**Return.** A receipt with `appointment_event_id` (reference number of the new refund entry), `appointment_id`, `disposition` (always "refunded"), `amount` (the amount refunded, USD with 2 decimal places) and `deposit_held_usd` (the deposit still held on the visit after the refund, USD with 2 decimal places). The presence of `appointment_event_id` confirms the refund was recorded; afterwards the appointment shows the lower deposit held and the history lists the refund entry.
